summary: Visium Technologies filed an 8-K/A amending its April 16, 2026 Current Report to correct Item 3.02 and withdraw certain Item 8.01 statements. The Board determined that no shares of Series G Governing Preferred Stock were ever issued on April 14, 2026 or thereafter; no consideration was received, no certificates delivered, and no holder recorded, so the prior issuance statement is withdrawn. The Series G Certificate of Designation filing with Florida stands, but its deletion is reported separately. Series A and B Convertible Preferred remain outstanding on existing terms, and diluted EPS will be computed under ASC 260.
